headline: Trade war in focus at ASEAN summit ahead of Trump’s arrival
summary: Southeast Asian leaders are grappling with the US trade war and regional flashpoints at a summit in Manila. The meeting takes place ahead of US President Donald Trump's arrival.
why: ASEAN is a bloc of ten Southeast Asian states whose economies are closely tied to global trade and supply chains. Tariff disputes between the US and Asian partners affect exporters, manufacturers and regional currencies.
